# Tutorial: Get started with {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %} In this tutorial, you create a small recipe app while learning the key features of {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %}. You work with files and the user interface, preview and debug the app, customize settings, explore optional extensions, and save your work with Git. The tutorial uses plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with no additional extensions, build tools, runtime, AI account, or coding assistant required. > [!TIP] > If you prefer a video introduction to {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %}, watch the [Getting Started video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f8_uF_IDV50) on our YouTube channel.
Learn about the key features of {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %} in our introduction video. * [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f8_uF_IDV50)
